errors.text_span: Ос Y е етикетирана с „НИРД като % от БВП“
errors.evidence: The Y-axis is not labeled. The phrase 'НИРД като % от БВП' is the title of the chart, not the Y-axis label.

errors.text_span: и завършва при около 1,95% в края на времевия интервал
errors.evidence: The blue line representing the EU does not end at 1.95%. It clearly ends at a value above 2.0, approximately at 2.05%.

errors.text_span: постепенно се увеличава до около 0,5% в средата на периода
errors.evidence: The description of the orange line for Bulgaria is inaccurate. At the midpoint of the period (the 5th data point), the value is approximately 0.6%, not 0.5%. The description also misses the initial fluctuations.

errors.text_span: като разликата между двете линии е най-голяма в края на времевия интервал
errors.evidence: This comparative statement is incorrect. The visual gap between the two lines is larger at the beginning (approx. 1.8 - 0.45 = 1.35) than at the end (approx. 2.05 - 0.75 = 1.3).
The description fails to mention the dotted polynomial trend lines that are plotted alongside the solid data lines for both series (EU and Bulgaria).
